verdicts.reason: The two candidates are practically identical, and both fail in the same ways. The photo is cropped and upscaled until it pixelates, losing the racket and ball composition. A stray blue horizontal bar cuts across the image and forms a cross with the narrow blue column. The headline breaks one word per line ('Win / a / study / grant'). 'by submitting / to' and 'Xavier Sport Program' are left-aligned and far apart, while the headline is centred. The divider rules and the white frame are lost or become stray slivers. The only differences are a few tiny stray line fragments.
